display.purpose: The h1 only — one per page.

chip.purpose: Pills and role tags. Always 800 weight.

shadows.name: sh-1
shadows.purpose: Feature cards, contact cards, accordion items. Barely there.

shadows.name: sh-2

motion.purpose: The page's only easing. Colour transitions on buttons, nav links and accordion summaries, 180ms; the accordion chevron rotates over 300ms.

components.name: Primary Button

components.description: White with a 2px border, for a second action that must not compete with the primary.

components.description: Labels a fact or an audience. Never interactive. 8px radius — a quarter of its ~30px height.

components.name: Step Number
components.description: The numeral beside each step. A rounded square, not a circle — it belongs to the same shape family as the icon slot.

components.name: Icon Slot
components.description: 46px square holding a 22px Lucide glyph. The slot whose 12px-on-46px ratio became the page's whole radius rule. The glyph carries no colour of its own.

components.name: Content Card
components.description: The step columns. 20px radius, the page's largest, with the middle shadow.

narrative.overview:
This page took the standing exit in its direction round: the education-SaaS page done at the category standard, executed at full fidelity rather than subverted. Two earlier worlds were built and discarded — an angular ruled class-register, then a hand-invented blue — and the lesson of both is written into the rule below: nothing on this surface is invented.

The palette is not a brand palette designed for marketing. It is the application's own light theme, copied token-for-token out of frontend/src/App.css in the EdUp repo and kept under the same names, so the two surfaces can be diffed line by line. A visitor who clicks Logi sisse should not experience a change of world. The proof image is not an illustration of the product; it is a screenshot of it. The copy is the product owner's own Estonian.

The one composed decision is the shape language, and it is stated once: the corner radius tracks the size of the box, at roughly a quarter of its side. That ratio was already latent in the icon slots (12px on a 46px square) and is now the whole page's rule, which is why nothing here is a pill or a circle.
keyCharacteristics: Left-aligned throughout; the content edge holds across every section but one — the õpipuu figure, which is deliberately wider.
Alternating bg-primary / surface-sub bands give section rhythm without rules or dividers.
Every icon is Lucide, inlined, inheriting currentColor — never given a colour of its own.
Two hues only: a blue that carries every interactive surface, and an amber that appears exactly once.
One borrowed constant beside them: the wordmark's own blue, on the wordmark's own letters and nowhere else.
No JavaScript. The page is static HTML and renders complete with scripting off.

rules.name: The Borrowed Palette Rule
rules.body: Every colour on this page is the application's own token under the application's own name. If a value needs to change, change it in frontend/src/App.css first and bring it across. Never tune a colour here to suit the marketing page — that is how the two surfaces drift into looking like two products.

rules.name: The Wordmark Blue Is Not A Palette Colour
rules.body: brand-blue (#32448A) is the logo's own blue, recorded in PRODUCT.md § Brand Commitments — not an App.css token, and the one value on this page that does not come from the application. It exists so the "Up" in the h1 matches the wordmark sitting directly above it, and it is used on those two letters and nowhere else. It is deliberately not accent-strong (#2D5B88): with the real logo in the masthead a few hundred pixels up, a near-miss would read as a mistake rather than as a second blue.

rules.name: The Two Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Borders are rgba() black at 9% and 6%, not a grey. They sit on both surface-card and surface-sub without a seam, which a fixed grey cannot do across two backgrounds.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose is capped: 66ch for body paragraphs, 58ch for leads, 48ch inside step bodies, 46ch inside feature cards. The page is wide; the reading line is not.

rules.name: The Art Direction Rule
rules.body: The õpirada figure is not one image scaled. Below 760px a <picture> swaps to a separate capture of the application's own portrait layout, because a wide screenshot shrunk to phone width is unreadable, not responsive.

rules.name: The Quarter-Side Rule
rules.body: The corner radius is about a quarter of the box's shorter side, so it grows with the element instead of collapsing to a pill: 8px for chips and step numbers, 12px for buttons, icon slots, images and accordion items, 20px for cards and figures. Nothing on the page is border-radius 999px or 50%.

rules.name: The Ladder Is Not Decoration
rules.body: The five skill-* greens (plus the orange at the bottom) are the application's achievement ramp, copied from App.css --skill-* along with the --color-green family it rides. They appear only in the õpipuu panel, where each one means a rung. The stylesheet keeps App.css's color-mix() expressions rather than resolved hexes so the two surfaces cannot drift. There is deliberately no skill-none: "not started" is an absence, drawn as an outline. Never use a ladder colour for anything that is not a rung.

rules.name: The One Wide Section Rule
rules.body: #opirada uses .wrap--wide (1520px) because the õpipuu is the page's proof and cannot be both legible and narrow: the tree is a raster with a fixed aspect, so at the 1180px column a readable rendering was 647px tall and pushed the summary panel below it. The extra width buys the panel a column beside the tree. This is the only section allowed to opt out, its left edge does move relative to the rest of the page, and that cost was accepted knowingly.

dos: Do take colours from frontend/src/App.css and keep the token name.
Do use Lucide for every glyph, inlined, with no color or stroke attribute so it inherits currentColor.
Do pick a radius by the size of the box, not by the kind of component.
Do cap every run of prose with a ch measure.
donts: Don't introduce a pill or a circle. The shape language has three steps and none of them is round.
Don't add a third hue. Amber appears once, deliberately, and brand-blue is reserved for the letters of the wordmark.
Don't load a font, script, or asset from a third-party origin — EU data residency is a product constraint, not a preference.
Don't add JavaScript for presentation. The page currently ships none.
Don't claim anything the evidence list in PRODUCT.md doesn't support: there are no testimonials, no named pilot schools, no efficacy data, and a marketing surface is exactly where those get invented.
Don't ship a screenshot without checking it for real pupil data, and disclose authored demo marks as such.
Don't use a skill-* green for anything that is not a rung of the achievement ladder.
